parameters.name: epsilon_near_top_relative
inputs: training public native probability projections only

parameters.name: scenario_feature_definitions_and_action_predicates
parameters.procedure: JM2-A1 define bounded implementable feature set, units/missing/population and role contrast. Shared function for historical/current; omit unimplemented future packing/critical path features. JM2-A3 blind sufficiency review requires all predicates supported, otherwise reject.

parameters.name: R1_score_threshold
parameters.procedure: Freeze candidate family first: structural/action gates mandatory, ranking uses shared corrected nine-dimensional score, max_entries=1 and old whole-entry budgets. Threshold candidates = sorted distinct tune scores union {0.5, reject_all}; no LLM reranker. Eligible settings have zero forbidden-transfer injections, at least one labeled applicable accepted state in each declared stage/action stratum, and macro-source applicable precision >= R0. Choose greatest macro-source applicable recall, then precision, then fewer UNKNOWN injections, then higher threshold. No eligible candidate => DEFER. Freeze once before opening lock labels; lock failure needs new preregistered verification version and new isolated material.

parameters.name: local_minimum_effect_and_noise
inputs: frozen authorized training task size summaries private design side
valid pre-registered JM1 repeated-action final volume ratios
parameters.procedure: delta_box = lower median across training tasks of (smallest item volume / full task volume). noise = max absolute same-action volume-ratio difference over complete registered repeat pairs. Freeze delta_local=max(delta_box,noise,1e-9), before local results. Need >=2 distinct training starts and >=2 source groups with complete valid repeat pairs; no repeat/invalid identities => DEFER, not noise=0. These are descriptive resolution/noise allowances, not a confidence interval.

parameters.name: evaluation_effect_sample_size_repeats
inputs: JM4-B frozen developer paired source differences and registered within-task repeats
eligible source register before eval outcomes
parameters.procedure: Current route is descriptive only. At JM5-A1 freeze eligible source/material group inventory and cutoff without eval outcomes; choose one canonical task per group sorted by source then task digest. N=min(eligible group count, separately approved positive integer source cap), R=2 common repeats. If N=0, any grouping UNKNOWN, cap absent, or cost/send matrix not approved => DEFER. Target practical effect is training delta_box from local-threshold contract, materialize before eval. No power calculation or inferential CI in this version. An inferential study requires a separately revised analysis contract and independently reviewed sample-size/multiplicity procedure before evaluation; not selectable from evaluation results.

common_rules.unknown_numeric: typed NOT_MATERIALIZED, never null/0 meaning ready
common_rules.send_gate: all required parameters materialized as finite typed numeric or explicitly excluded research stratum; no pending field crosses its deadline
common_rules.revision: new immutable version, no retroactive change or hidden result-dependent selection
